name: Aymen Bareche
summary: Senior Full-Stack Engineer with 10 years of experience in web development, including nearly 7 years building real estate platforms at Homeday in Berlin. Specialized in the Vue.js ecosystem with hands-on production experience in Ruby on Rails, Node.js, and cloud infrastructure. Proven track record of modernizing legacy codebases, shipping end-to-end features independently, and building tools that speed up product and operations teams.

highlights: Built and shipped end-to-end product features across Vue.js 2&3, TypeScript frontends and Ruby on Rails REST APIs, focusing on real estate agent tooling, seller insights, and legal compliance workflows.
Expanded from frontend into Ruby on Rails and infrastructure AWS to deliver full-stack features independently and remove bottlenecks between squads.
Refactored a core legacy frontend application into modular codebase with reduced bundle size, improving load and runtime performance by 15–20% and making the codebase easier to test and extend.
Built internal support tools and wrote troubleshooting documentation that let operations and support teams resolve routine issues without escalating to engineering.
Received internal company awards for technical ownership and cross-team delivery.
Developed core features across multiple Vue.js 2 applications, building shared components to keep UI consistent with the company design system.
Rebuilt a legacy buyer onboarding and property searching flow, modernizing the codebase and layout which improved usability and increased user conversion rates by 15%.
Maintained technical and analytics tracking documentation to keep product and engineering squads aligned.
Conducted technical interviews and coding assessments for frontend candidates (hiring two engineers) and ran internal knowledge-sharing sessions.
Built backend and frontend features for an internal newsroom CMS using Node.js, Express, Vue.js 2, Vuex, and REST APIs.
Migrated key modules of a legacy Angular application to Vue.js 2 to simplify maintenance and reduce UI bugs.

Developed and shipped Smart TV applications (Samsung, LG, Alliance) and a high-traffic HbbTV video-on-demand (VOD) app reaching millions of viewers, complete with ad integration and custom analytics tracking.
Set up Jenkins CI/CD pipelines, integrated Sentry for error monitoring, and wrote unit and integration tests using Mocha, Chai, and Istanbul within an AWS/Docker environment.
Refactored a legacy PHP codebase into a modular MVC architecture for a white-label insurance platform, improving system stability and deployment speed.
Built customer-facing and internal features using JavaScript, jQuery, Bootstrap, REST APIs, and MySQL.
Created internal automation tools for operations staff, including a cloud-based document printing system and a document scanner with auto-fill capabilities.
Managed Linux deployments on DigitalOcean and maintained WordPress modules with technical SEO optimizations.

additionalInformation: Permanent resident of Germany (Niederlassungserlaubnis) – Work authorization granted.
